assertions.subject: Tricuspid Regurgitation
assertions.quote: The 2 main tricuspid regurgitation types are primary and secondary

assertions.subject: Secondary Tricuspid Regurgitation
assertions.quote: its incidence is approximately 90% among patients with tricuspid regurgitation

assertions.subject: Primary Tricuspid Regurgitation
assertions.quote: Primary tricuspid regurgitation is less common and caused by anatomical involvement of tricuspid valve structures

assertions.subject: Secondary Tricuspid Regurgitation
assertions.quote: The most common causes of secondary tricuspid regurgitation are left-sided valvular or myocardial pathologies and pulmonary hypertension
